_howto: One entry per brand/product. Drop assets in site/assets/work/<slug>/ (or reuse existing paths), add the entry here, then run: node dashboard/build-work.js — it generates site/work/<slug>/index.html and refreshes site/work/index.html. media[].type is 'video' or 'image'; media[].tag is the content-type label shown on the item (hero shot, ugc reel, macro, packaging...). cover = src of the media item used on the index card.

brands.name: haircare — ugc campaign
brands.blurb: creator-style content for a haircare brand — an AI presenter in a real living room, zero casting calls, zero shoot days.

brands.name: eyeliner — product film
brands.blurb: a macro product film for a precision eyeliner — penthouse light, skyline backdrop, editorial pacing. built for feed, web and retail screens.

brands.name: hair dryer — hero reel
brands.blurb: an x-ray hero reel for a performance hair dryer — the motor rendered mid-flight, copper coils and airflow visible. a shot no camera could take.

brands.name: ikonic professional — haircare tools
brands.blurb: a two-piece hero system for a professional haircare line — dryer and straightener, matte-black studio light, engineered-product pacing built for retail and e-commerce screens.

brands.name: olivia — suncare campaign
brands.blurb: a full content system for Olivia Ultra Protect+ sunscreen — a botanical hero film built on light and ingredient story, paired with a creator-style UGC ad for in-feed reach.

brands.name: flextail — ugc review
brands.blurb: a creator-style outdoor review comparing a compact power device to an iPhone for scale — handheld pacing, natural light, built to read as authentic in-feed content.

brands.name: timepiece — strap collection film
brands.blurb: spec concept work: a monochrome reveal for a steel watch and its interchangeable leather straps — droplet-transition open, macro light on brushed metal, the versatility story a strap collection is built to sell.
